mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_online_session (acct_session_id, username, username_mask, mac, nas_ip, framed_ip, ssid, nas_name, status, start_time) VALUES (#{acctSessionId}, #{username}, #{usernameMask}, #{mac}, #{nasIp}, #{framedIp}, #{ssid}, #{nasName}, 1, IFNULL(#{startTime}, NOW())) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE username = COALESCE(VALUES(username), username), username_mask = COALESCE(VALUES(username_mask), username_mask), mac = COALESCE(VALUES(mac), mac), nas_ip = COALESCE(VALUES(nas_ip), nas_ip), framed_ip = COALESCE(VALUES(framed_ip), framed_ip), ssid = COALESCE(VALUES(ssid), ssid), nas_name = COALESCE(VALUES(nas_name), nas_name), status = 1
